title: Collaboration or Corporate Capture? Quantifying NLP's Reliance on Industry Artifacts and Contributions

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying 100 EMNLP 2022 papers to classify author affiliations (academia, industry, non-profit) and analyzing the proportion of industry-affiliated citations for datasets, pre-trained models, and prior benchmarks against expected baseline publication rates to quantify the field's systemic reliance on corporate artifacts and advantages from the compute divide.

Tracking the publishing institution type of surveyed papers and comparing it to the institution types of their cited artifacts and prior bests to determine if authors have an in-group predisposition to cite research originating from their own sector.
